items.title: Reddit Sinks 8% as Social Ad Worries Deepen in Tech Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 8% today after Snap reported just 4% ad revenue growth, in a broad tech selloff. Meta’s 26% revenue growth last quarter suggests advertisers are still spending on the biggest social platform, so Snap’s slowdown looks like Snap’s own problem.

items.title: Workers Caught In 'The Great 2026 Mass Layoff Wave' Share What Life Looks Like Now. 'Been Playing A Lot Of Video Games, But…'
items.summary: Months after losing their jobs, workers caught up in what one Reddit user recently called “the great 2026 mass layoff wave” are sharing what their lives look like now. For some, that means a new job, often with lower pay....

items.title: Pinterest Sinks 5% as Reddit Down 5% on Sluggish Ad Sales Amid Tech Selloff
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPinterest shares fell 7% today, along with Reddit, after Snap reported 4% ad growth during a broad tech selloff. Snap’s sluggish ad sales echo Pinterest’s report last week, when ad prices fell 4% and its fourth-quarter guide missed estimates.

items.title: Snap Tumbles 11% as User Growth Miss and Sluggish Ad Sales Overshadow Return to Profit; Pinterest Dips, Meta Holds Steady
items.summary: Snap finally made money, yet traders rushed for the exits. A quiet change in how the company counts its audience, plus a stubborn ad problem, has investors asking whether this turnaround is built on the right foundation.

items.title: My Sister Has $300,000 in Grandma’s Trust but the Trustee Says No to Rent and Braces, Can She Fight Back Without Losing It All?
items.summary: A California trustee keeps blocking a single mother's requests for braces and rent while billing management fees against her $300,000 trust share, and a no-contest clause looms over every move she makes. Here is what California law actually lets her do without risking the inheritance.

items.title: Reddit Begins Search Ads Test
items.summary: Reddit is testing ad placements in search with a select group of advertisers. Ad delivery in search will depend on contextual relevance to a user's search query, and other factors.
